done_when: test_long_unattended_chain_hidden_tab_with_failure_timeout_and_dropped_reply is still collected and asserts the same things, run_page timeout is scaled by MTS_BROWSER_TIMEOUT_SCALE (default 3x for this test), run_all_tests.py TEST_FILE_SECONDS lists test_aibridge_chain.py at 140 s so the shard balancer isolates it, and 3 consecutive ship --full runs on JIS-LAPTOP pass step 4b.
goal: The AIBridge 54-block hidden-tab test stops failing sync.py ship step 4b under load: its headless-Chrome call has a 240 s cap against a 137 s quiet run, and the gate budgets it at 2 s.
note: Never skip or delete the test. CI is green; only the loaded JIS-LAPTOP gate trips.
steps: Cause (read, do not re-derive): tests/aibridge_dom.py run_page() runs headless Chrome with --virtual-time-budget and subprocess.run(timeout=<arg>); test_aibridge_chain.py:51 passes timeout=240 and budget 950000 ms. Alone it takes ~137 s, so under a loaded gate (4 pool steps) 240 s wall is exceeded -> subprocess.TimeoutExpired. Also run_all_tests.py TEST_FILE_SECONDS has no entry for test_aibridge_chain.py, so the shard balancer counts 2 s and parks it in 4b beside other files; FAST_STEP_TIMEOUT_S=240 caps the whole shard in smoke mode.

In tests/aibridge_dom.py run_page: read float env MTS_BROWSER_TIMEOUT_SCALE (default 1.0; bad value -> 1.0) and pass timeout=int(timeout*scale) to subprocess.run; keep the signature. Label DECISION (OURS).
In test_aibridge_chain.py:51 raise the call to timeout=480 (OURS: 3.5x the 137 s quiet run). Assertions unchanged.

In run_all_tests.py TEST_FILE_SECONDS add test_aibridge_chain.py: 140 (measured alone 137 s) so the greedy balancer gives it a shard of its own, and the SLOW_FILE_S>=30 rule keeps it out of the targeted precheck.

If step 4b's shard timeout (FAST_STEP_TIMEOUT_S 240) still cuts the shard in --full mode, check step_timeout_for(mode): only smoke gets 240; if full/ship step 4b is capped, add a per-step override for the shard holding this file (e.g. 600 s). Verify by reading run_all_tests.py:226-250 and 745-747 before editing.
Add MyTradingSys/tests/test_aibridge_chain_budget.py with the two failing-first tests (see tests field); confirm they fail on the pre-change code via git stash of the three edits.
Run the chain test alone (pytest -k hidden_tab), then sync.py ship --full once; report step 4b time.
tests: New test in MyTradingSys/tests/test_aibridge_chain_budget.py: (a) TEST_FILE_SECONDS in run_all_tests has test_aibridge_chain.py >= 120 (fails on old code: absent); (b) run_page's subprocess timeout equals timeout*scale (monkeypatch subprocess.run, env scale=2 -> timeout 480; fails on old code: fixed). Then run the chain test alone and one ship --full.
title: test_aibridge_chain hidden-tab test (test_long_unattended_chain_hidden_tab_with_failure_timeout_and_dropped_reply) times out under load on headless Chrome and blocks sync.py ship step 4b; passes alone.
